title: Killed 'a scarred slag-hound' in the Flooded Quarry den (Iron Downs), matching Ness's description of something 'prowling the downs after dark,' but the status screen kept 'The Slag-Hound' listed as an open quest for the rest of the game — Ness has no dialogue option to report the kill, unlike the near-identical Wardmoor quests (Dark Beacon, Lost Sentry) which both had explicit report options and clear 'Quest done' messages.
where: The Head-Frame (Ness) / the Flooded Quarry — den
